content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

Section 18 (¶¶ p0073–p0074) satisfies every preferred INSURANCE element:

| Element | Document |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M per occurrence | "at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence" |
| CGL USD 2M aggregate | "USD 2,000,000 aggregate" |
| E&O USD 2M | "professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000" |
| Cyber USD 5M where Customer Data processed | "cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000" (unconditional, so broader than our conditional ask) |
| Workers' comp as required by law | "workers' compensation as required by law" |
| Certificates on request | § 18.2 "On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance" |

Vendor also carries a one-year post-term tail, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, primary-coverage wording, notice of cancellation/material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit its liabilities — all Customer-favourable and left untouched. Additional-insured status is not in the checklist; noted only, not flagged.
